verdict.rationale: The evidence shows memories can be updated: the CLI supports update and delete, the MCP tools let an agent decide to 'update what it already knows,' and webhooks fire on 'updated' events. Mem0 also extracts discrete facts on add and describes itself as 'self-improving.' No item documents the layer automatically detecting a contradiction and superseding or merging the stored memory, so updates appear to be manual or agent-driven rather than something a developer can rely on the layer to do. Missing for 10: documented automatic contradiction detection and supersede/merge logic on add, a description of how conflicting facts are resolved, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
